msg: Probing disk before trusting the card. Card cited run_longrun.py:436/:441 for the reset/grow hooks — those lines hold projected_requests/allocation_for, not the hooks. Real hook code located by grep.

Three predicates located. (1) grow eviction run_longrun.py:1063-1072 `while len(parts) > 1 and est_tokens('\n\n'.join(parts+[current]), bpt) > self.wall_tokens: parts.pop(0); evicted += 1` → row field `evicted`. (2) compact digest run_longrun.py:1080-1088 `if t > 1 and est_tokens(window, bpt) > self.wall_tokens: info['digest_request'] = ...` → NO turn-row marker; the only row-level trace is a separate row with kind=='digest' (run_longrun.py:2027). (3) lease reopen run_longrun.py:1112-1116 `if t in self.walls and self.lease_start <= t: self.lease = 1 + sum(...)` where self.walls = fixture.get('lease_reopen_turns') → row field `lease`. NOTE: reopen is NOT a token predicate at all, so the 64k wall story does not explain it.

All 12 runtime fixtures (tasks-v2..v6 LR-0*.json) carry wall_tokens=65536 and lease_reopen_turns=ABSENT. So the wall is a constant across every grid, and the reopen key was never declared — two independent causes, not one.

Envelope from rows: max prompt in the 4 controlled grids 34279 (rows-longrun-c T48 grow, run longrun-c-v2-2026-10-26-transcript-grow-r1); corpus-wide ceiling 51216 (policy fragment T14) — ARM-INTEGRITY's 1.9x is grid-scoped, 1.28x corpus-wide. Slopes: G4 grow 684.36 tok/turn, G4 compact 75.02, stage1 grow 38.53, stage1 compact 111.79, v3 grow 60.68, v4 grow 61.00. At wall 65536 the fire turns are T94/T847/T1654/T571/T1046/T1010 — all > 48.

Forced simulations via the real Planner + make_row (dry_run, in-memory fixture variant): grow wall=4762 T12 evicted=1; compact wall=4762 T12 kind='digest'; reopen lease_reopen_turns=[12] T12 lease=2. 7/7 tests pass; the RED control (shipped inputs, 48 turns) leaves all three at 0/0/1.

Parameter block: N=48 (PARM-1 frozen), wall_tokens=3838 (fixture), lease_reopen_turns=[23,40] (fixture), bytes_per_token=4.0914 (fixture), expected_digests=2 (RUNNER constant run_longrun.py:1133-1135, not fixture-derived; a 3rd digest aborts at exit 4 because budget=n_turns+2 at :424).

Price: A* 576 turns x 1.374532 = 792. Firing grid at 48 turns = 792 + 6 digests = 798 (+0.76%); eviction and reopen are host-side, 0 requests. N=56 (needed only for the SECOND registered wall, digest T53 / reopen T56) = 672 turns = 924 + 6 = 930 (+138). Ledger 3219: 4 firing grids fit at 48 turns, 3 at N=56. Horizon stays 48.

Delivered ARM-TREATMENTS.json/.md, probe tool, test, unit card, handoff (partial). Blocker: at the frozen parameters 6 growth arm/grid pairs are unreachable at 48 turns and lease-reopen is unreachable at any N. Secondary: compaction has no turn-row marker, and G4's grow-cell answers ran ~9x longer than compact's, confounding slope with verbosity.
